# CANDIDATE: RSI_EXTREME_RIBBON_ALIGNMENT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When momentum reaches an extreme while the EMA ribbon is uniformly aligned, the market is prone to a short‑term reversal. Entry rule: If RSI(14) ≥ 80 and the 8/21/34/55 EMA ribbon is bearish (8<21<34<55) on the same 5‑minute bar, enter short at the bar’s close; conversely, if RSI ≤ 20 and the ribbon is bullish (8>21>34>55), enter long at the bar’s close.

## Mechanism

Entry: On a 5-minute bar, if RSI(14) ≥ 80 and the 8/21/34/55 EMA ribbon is bearish (8<21<34<55), enter short at the bar’s close; if RSI ≤ 20 and the ribbon is bullish (8>21>34>55), enter long at the bar’s close. Exit: Initial stop placed beyond the most recent swing point (chart‑stop). Take profit at 1× risk or when RSI returns to the 40‑60 zone, whichever comes first; remaining position can trail with a chandelier exit set at 20% below the highest‑high‑since‑entry for longs (or above lowest‑low for shorts).
